name: Windy Capital
source:
You play as the character Merlandi Hertova, a war relief raised in another country. Now she's finished high school and is thinking about doing something for her war torn homeland. Consequences has lead her to hosting a docudrama series intended for studying the human nature, the Windy Capital.

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/router-jax/art/Windy-Capital-The-Visual-Novel-87926705]the Official site[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演梅兰迪·赫托瓦。她是战争难民，在异国长大，如今刚刚高中毕业，正思考能为饱受战火摧残的祖国做些什么。机缘巧合之下，她成为纪实剧集《风之都》的主持人，以节目探索人性。

[译自 [url=https://www.deviantart.com/router-jax/art/Windy-Capital-The-Visual-Novel-87926705]官方网站[/url]]
